questions.question:
105 is related to 15 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 154 is related to 22.To which of the following is 189 related following the same logic?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: (1st number ÷ 7 = 2nd number).

Now,

For, 105 : 15

⇒ 105 ÷ 7 = 15.

For, 154 : 22

⇒ 154 ÷ 7 = 22.

Similarly, for 189 : ?

⇒ 189 ÷ 7 = 27.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged?

46 × 17 + 4 ÷ 98 - 7 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/072439eb3d7cc1f9cfd9a5f7ce8addc8eefa357a1c62ee249221e25d5071dfd3.png] 

Given equation: 46 × 17 + 4 ÷ 98 - 7 = ?

Now, if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '-' and '÷' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 46 + 17 × 4 - __**98 ÷ 7**__ = ?

⇒ 46 + __**17 × 4**__ - 14 = ?

⇒ __**46 + 68**__ - 14 = ?

⇒ __**114 - 14**__ = **100.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

2006 to 2011 = 5 Years (4 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 5 Years = 1 Leap year and 4 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 4 Ordinary Years have 4 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 4 = 6.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

91 × 7 + 27 - 7 ÷ 13 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 91 × 7 + 27 - 7 ÷ 13 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ __**91 ÷ 7**__ - 27 + 7 × 13 = ?

⇒ 13 - 27 + __**7 × 13**__ = ?

⇒ __**13**__ - 27 __**+ 91**__ = ?

⇒ **__104 - 27__** = 77.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
